_doc: BRIEF SCHEMA + reconciliation rules. 'Lock more, ask more' posture (target user: marketing manager, not pro designer). Brand governs IDENTITY; brief governs OCCASION. Reconciliation = lock-level lookup, not judgment.

lock_levels.hard_lock: Brand value is final. Brief CANNOT override. If brief tries, refuse + keep brand value.
lock_levels.default_strong: Brand value is the default. Brief may NUDGE within range (bounded), not replace. Tension resolved by scoping brief adjective to the brand medium.
lock_levels.default_weak: Brand value is a default. Brief freely overrides.

brand_field_locks._note: Per-brand tagging of how locked each spec field is. This IS the reconciliation engine — brief input is checked against the field's lock level.
brand_field_locks.subject: brief_owned

brief_schema._note: Minimum viable brief. 4 hard-required slots + bounded optional. Tool ONLY asks a follow-up when a hard_required slot is missing (completeness guardrail). Resist adding more fields.

subject.prompt_if_missing: What is the material for / what should it show? (e.g. 'new spicy chicken burger')

asset_type.prompt_if_missing: What format? (poster / social square / vertical / banner)

occasion.prompt_if_missing: What's the occasion? (new launch / seasonal / promo / event)

headline_message.prompt_if_missing: What's the main message or headline text?

mood_shift._note: bounded nudge WITHIN brand tone, never a replacement

guardrails.completeness: If any hard_required slot is empty -> ASK (single targeted question per missing slot). Never guess a hard slot.
guardrails.identity: If brief attempts to set a hard_lock field (e.g. 'make the logo blue', 'use a serif font', 'change the red') -> REFUSE, keep brand value, tell the user that field is brand-locked.
guardrails.coherence: If brief mood conflicts with a default_strong field (e.g. 'fresh & light' vs ornamental red-gold) -> do NOT override; SCOPE the brief adjective to the brand medium ('a fresh, light INTERPRETATION of the ornamental red-gold brand').

reconciliation_example_aia._scenario: Designer brief: 'new senior health checkup plan, reassuring, for a vertical poster, headline 守护长辈健康'

merged_prompt_fields.imagery_style: modern geometric mountain planes, clean white space (default_strong, brand default kept)
merged_prompt_fields.subject: senior health checkup, older adults (brief_owned)
merged_prompt_fields.headline: 守护长辈健康 (brief_owned)

reconciliation_example_aia._result: Brand identity fully preserved; campaign-specific subject/occasion/message supplied by brief; mood nudged not replaced. No field is governed by both.
